whenToUse: A podcast or audio show with an episode player, chapters, archive and transcripts.
Shows whose episodes carry notes, recipes or credits on their own page.
avoidWhen: Articles and essays without audio — use site-blog-01.
a11y: Live captions and the following transcript use aria-live and aria-current; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Ensure the waveform scrubber is operable by keyboard and has an accessible name and value.
